title: pointer speed for mouse and touchpad

clauses.text: the Mouse slower and faster buttons change the mouse speed at once and the value is kept after a restart

steps.do: In Settings, Keyboard, row Pointer speed, press the Mouse faster key ( . ) a few times, then the slower key ( , ).
steps.expect: The pointer speed changes at each press, in steps of 5 percent.

steps.do: Restart the computer and check the Pointer speed row.
steps.expect: The value is the same as before the restart.

clauses.text: the Touchpad slower and faster buttons change the pad's speed at once

steps.do: In Settings, Keyboard, Pointer speed, press the Touchpad faster button, then move one finger across the trackpad.
steps.expect: The pointer moves faster than before, and the Touchpad value on the row goes up.
